data.body: 2026-07-31: Fixed Windows NSIS packaging so Adashi binaries install machine-wide under Program Files rather than mixing with settings in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Adashi. Added bundle.windows.nsis.installMode = perMachine in src-tauri/tauri.conf.json. Regenerated the NSIS artifact and verified its generated script declares INSTALLMODE perMachine, RequestExecutionLevel admin, and PROGRAMFILES64\Adashi. Checked and regenerated the MSI: WiX already emits InstallScope=perMachine and ProgramFiles64Folder\Adashi, and the packaged MSI database reports ALLUSERS=1 and INSTALLDIR parent ProgramFiles64Folder. No MSI config change was required. Verification also included valid JSON, Tauri config parsing via npx tauri info, git diff --check, successful NSIS packaging, and successful MSI packaging outside the restricted sandbox because WiX ICE validation requires the Windows Installer service. Existing %LOCALAPPDATA% installation is not moved automatically; uninstall it before installing the rebuilt package to
